findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed an empty water dispenser bottle inside the handwashing sink and storage containers placed on the floor directly in front of the sink, restricting access. The person in charge (PIC) was instructed to remove the items for easy access to the handwashing sink. The inspector will follow-up on 02/06/2026 to verify compliance. Ensure the handwashing sink remains accessible at all times.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [PF]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed soil accumulation in the soda machine nozzles. The PIC was informed and instructed to clean the nozzles. The inspector will follow-up on 02/06/2026 to verify the nozzles are cleaned to sight and touch. Ensure all food-contact surfaces are free of soil accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [PF]

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Inspector observed two containers of hand wash liquid soap stored on a shelf above packaged coffee and Slim-Jim snacks in the dry storage area. CORRECTED - The PIC was informed, and the soaps were relocated to an appropriate storage area. Ensure poisonous or toxic materials are stored separately and not placed above food or food-contact items.
findings.citation_text: 7-201.11 Separation. Poisonous or toxic materials shall be stored so they can not contaminate food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single-service and single-use articles by: (A) Separating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS by spacing or partitioning; and (B) Locating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS in an area that is not above FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE or SINGLE-USE ARTICLES. [P]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Inspector observed that no ambient thermometer was present in the walk-in cooler. The PIC was instructed to install an ambient thermometer in the walk-in cooler before the next routine inspection. Ensure an ambient thermometer is always located in the walk-in cooler to monitor proper cold-holding temperatures.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed dust accumulation on the walk-in cooler fan cover and frozen ice accumulation on the fan casing. The PIC was informed and will ensure the fan cover and fan casing are cleaned and maintained before the next routine inspection. Ensure all non-food-contact surfaces are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Inspector observed no sanitizer available at the 3 part sink. Spray bottled contain PIne-Sol. A bag of quat sanitizer is available and was attached o the dispenser which is now delivering Quat based sanitizer at 200 ppm. The facility will continue to use the quat sanitizer and check the dispensing machine daily with test strips they have on hand. 
Inspector discussed at length the surfaces that require sanitizing which include the soda nozzles, coffee carafe and area above the coffee filter basket. The items are currently clean. If the popcorn machine is used that is also a food contact surface and would require sanitizing. 

Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitizers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on device and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Inspector observed the base cove to the right of the back to the dry storage area has a portion of base cove that is pulled away from the wall. Repair the base cove.
The caulk seals on the hand sinks in the restrooms are cracked. Provide new seals at the backs of the hand sinks. 

PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
